open_points.subject: A3 INV-009 Required tests
open_points.text: INV-009: at `assign_staff_project`, `grant_viewer_project` and `grant_producer_project`: a pair whose only record is revoked receives a new active record and the revoked one is unchanged; a pair with an active record is refused and nothing changes; and the storage refuses a second active record for a pair inserted past that check.
open_points.question: Must the required test show that every operation can create another active record when the pair already has multiple revoked historical records, preserving all of them, rather than only when its sole record is revoked?
options: Require re-assignment and re-grant after any number of revoke/recreate cycles, preserving every revoked record.
Require only the single-revoked-record case currently stated.
open_points.default_guess: Require the arbitrary-history case because the invariant places no limit on repeated revoke/recreate cycles.

witness.initial: A staff/project pair has two revoked assignment records left by two completed assignment-and-revocation cycles and has no active assignment.
events: An administrator calls `assign_staff_project` for the same pair a third time.
outcomes: A new active assignment is created and both revoked assignments remain unchanged.
The operation fails or cannot classify the pair because the implementation and its test assume that at most one historical record exists.
witness.observer: The administrator and the Factory verification check

open_points.subject: A31 concurrency security review
open_points.text: - concurrency: APPLICABLE; references: A8, A18, A19, A22, A29; affected: replay identities, single active budget version, bootstrap
open_points.question: Now that INV-009 and its storage-enforced single-active-record guarantee moved from A8 to A3, must the concurrency category reference A3 and explicitly cover concurrent creation of staff assignments, viewer grants and producer grants?
options: Add A3 and the three single-active assignment/grant cases to the concurrency review.
Declare explicitly that another cited decision completely resolves those races and identify it.
Leave the category unchanged, so the migrated guarantee has no stated concurrency-review owner.
open_points.default_guess: Add A3 and the assignment/grant races to the concurrency category.

witness.initial: A viewer/project pair has no active grant.
events: Two administrators concurrently call `grant_viewer_project`; both application-level checks observe no active grant.
The security reviewer follows A31's concurrency references after INV-009 has been removed from A8.
outcomes: A31 points to A3 and verifies that storage admits only one active grant and refuses the competing insertion.
A31 reviews A8's remaining replay identities but silently omits the moved single-active-grant race.
